query: Calculate the fare from Main Street to Elms Ave with QuickRide and MetroHail. DO NOT use f strings and nested function calls including type casting. Remember that tool calls might fail and use try/catch to set reasonable default values.

tools.name: QuickRideFareEstimate
tools.description: Estimate the QuickRide fare between two locations.

tools.name: MetroHailFareEstimate
tools.description: Estimate the MetroHail fare between two locations.

script:
def main():
    try:
        quickride_result: QuickRideFareEstimate = QuickRideFareEstimate(pickup="Main Street", destination="Elms Ave")
        quickride_fare: float = quickride_result.fare
    except Exception:
        quickride_fare = 0.0
    try:
        metrohail_result: MetroHailFareEstimate = MetroHailFareEstimate(pickup="Main Street", destination="Elms Ave")
        metrohail_fare: float = metrohail_result.fare
    except Exception:
        metrohail_fare = 0.0
    quickride_fare_str: str = str(quickride_fare)
    metrohail_fare_str: str = str(metrohail_fare)
    display("QuickRide fare: " + quickride_fare_str)
    display("MetroHail fare: " + metrohail_fare_str)
    return quickride_fare
final_output = main()
